decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play early on. It also utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six for control and consistency. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Prismatic Ending and Spell Pierce while setting up for powerful combos with Transmogrify and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The mana base is designed to enable fast and consistent plays, while Leyline Binding provides protection and disruption against opposing strategies. The key is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm opponents.

This deck focuses on utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to quickly fill the graveyard and take advantage of cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Goryo's Vengeance to quickly put pressure on the opponent. With a mix of discard spells, graveyard recursion, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and powerful threats. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a potential companion option to provide additional flexibility and consistency to the deck.

The deck revolves around quickly and efficiently milling through your library using cards like Spoils of the Vault, Undercity Informer, and Balustrade Spy to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle. By utilizing Angel's Grace to prevent losing the game from an empty library, the goal is to win in a single turn using Goblin Charbelcher's ability to deal lethal damage. This landless combo deck is focused on assembling the necessary pieces to execute a game-winning combo, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy in Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Archon of Cruelty to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards that can fetch multiple land types and generate mana, as well as cards that can control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to create a unique and unexpected win condition through creative card interactions. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker also adds versatility to the deck's strategy, allowing for different pathways to victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and aggressively to the opponent. It also takes advantage of the companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional consistency and mana acceleration. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. The deck aims to establish board presence early and apply pressure with threats like Territorial Kavu, Scion of Draco, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Nishoba Brawler, while having access to counterspells like Stubborn Denial for protection.

This deck focuses on assembling the powerful combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip massive amounts of equipment onto a creature, typically Inkmoth Nexus or Kaldra Compleat, for a devastating one-shot kill. The deck also includes powerful support cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Giver of Runes, and Spell Pierce to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts and lands, while Steelshaper's Gift and Blacksmith's Skill help to find and equip the necessary pieces for the combo.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a toolbox of creatures to create powerful combos and synergies. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the player can search for specific creatures needed for their game plan. Creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide provide utility and value, while cards like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf offer aggressive options. The deck aims to create a versatile and flexible game plan through its creature selections and combo potential.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy with efficient counter spells while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly deal damage and apply pressure. Additional utility is provided by cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and dig for key cards. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Brazen Borrower adds versatility and disruption to the deck, allowing the player to adapt to different matchups and strategies.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays through efficient removal spells, disruptive discard effects, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Blackcleave Cliffs to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while applying pressure with fast threats, the deck aims to control the board and overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck's strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's resources and breaking their defenses to push through for a fast victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also maintaining control with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to handle threats. The mana base includes lands that can produce both red and blue mana efficiently, allowing for consistent casting of spells. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by quickly deploying creatures and disrupting the opponent's hand and board state. By utilizing cards like Grief, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain it throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate provide disruption and removal options to control the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for extra value when trading creatures and potentially overwhelming the opponent. The deck also utilizes Blood Moon to disrupt opposing mana bases and gain an advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficiently disrupting opponents with targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize, while also presenting aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to apply early pressure and control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate. Additionally, the deck utilizes graveyard recursion and card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer and Kolaghan's Command to outvalue opponents. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Feign Death also allows for additional disruption and surprise tactics to keep opponents off balance.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while using cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect them. This deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, while also utilizing Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger for card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Kolaghan's Command adds additional disruption to ensure that the opponent is always on the back foot.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful threats and spells. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells like Condescend and Remand, and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Relic of Progenitus and Karn, the Great Creator. It can win with big threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Emrakul, the Promised End, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, while using utility lands like Academy Ruins and Blast Zone for added versatility. Overall, the deck is based on control and ramp to overpower opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures and spells with cascade abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells for free. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls, the deck can generate strong board presence and close out games quickly. Additionally, the deck includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect its threats and disrupt opposing strategies. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors to cast the cascade spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in its gameplay strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence through aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. With the support of removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, as well as card advantage from Mishra's Bauble and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of a companion, Jegantha, adds an additional powerful threat to the deck's strategy.
